body.name: locked-coordinate Hilbert-rank obstruction
body.construction: For \(S\subseteq\theta_{W_{\ell}^{(2)}}\setminus\{\zeta_{\ell}\}\), form \(m_{\zeta,S}:C_d(S)\to\bigl(A_d(S)+\zeta_{\ell}C_d(S)\bigr)/A_d(S)\), \(c\mapsto\zeta_{\ell}c+A_d(S)\), in exact monomial-image bases. Define \(\mathfrak H_{\ell,d}(S)\) as the sum of squares of all \(\dim C_d(S)\)-square minors of this matrix. Then \(\mathfrak H_{\ell,d}(S)\ne0\) exactly when \(A_d(S)\cap\zeta_{\ell}C_d(S)=\{0\}\).
